Textpectation

The impatience, excitement, or anxiety people feel while waiting for a reply to a digital message.

Explanation

Textpectation, a blend of "text" and "expectation," describes the emotional state created by instant-messaging cues like typing indicators and read receipts, where delayed replies trigger anxiety about being ignored. It matters for marketers because consumers now hold brands to the same instant-response standard they hold friends to, especially through chatbots and social media, and slow responses are read as a sign of brand indifference. Managing this expectation is both a risk and an opportunity for building consumer trust and emotional connection.

Related terms

CRM, chatbot, digital anxiety, response time, brand reliability, personalization
